judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is incomplete, stopping partway through its own Definition of Done. While it adds `ajv` to `package.json`, compiles schemas in `ToolRegistry.register`, and writes failing acceptance tests in `registry.acceptance.test.ts`, it completely omits the validation logic inside `ToolRegistry.execute`. As a result, three of the four new tests in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` runs. It also misses dynamic schema resolution/WeakMap caching, the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the doc comment on `execute`, and all documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`).
